name: Woman Yelling At Cat
look: Two photos side by side under a white strip for captions. Left: a blonde woman screams and points while a dark-haired woman holds her back. Right: a white cat sits at a dinner table behind a plate of salad, looking back with a sour, confused face.
use: The left caption is an angry accusation or complaint and the right caption is the cat's smug, oblivious or absurd reply, framing an argument between someone furious and someone completely unbothered.
slots: the angry accusation (above the yelling woman, left)
the cat's unbothered reply (above the cat, right)
examples: You said you'd be ready in five minutes!
I said I'd be ready, not that I'd be fast
Why is the couch covered in fur?
